NONE: › If a positive quality of someone's character is unfailing, it shows itself at all times.
（個人的優良品質）經久不衰的，一貫的
B1 not treating people in an equal way, or not morally right
不公平的，不公正的；不正當的

example: an unfair system
不公平的制度
[ + to infinitive ] It's unfair to blame Robert.
責備羅伯特是不公平的。

NONE: › having a sexual relationship or experience with a person who is not your husband, wife, or usual sexual partner
不忠的，通姦的

example: If a man was unfaithful to me I'd leave him no matter what the circumstances.
如果一個男人對我不忠，無論如何我都會離開他。

NONE: › never stopping or losing strength; not faltering
不搖晃的；堅定的；不動搖的
B2 not known to you
不熟悉的，陌生的
B2 to not have any knowledge or experience of something
對…不熟悉，不懂

example: I noticed several unfamiliar faces in the meeting room.
我注意到會議室裡有好幾張新面孔。
His name was unfamiliar to me.
他的名字我很陌生。
Many older people are unfamiliar with computers.
許多老年人不懂電腦。

NONE: B2 not modern or popular
不時髦的，不流行的，過時的

example: They paid less for the house because it was in an unfashionable part of town.
他們買的這個房子價格低一些，因為位置在城裡沒有那麼熱門的一個地方。

NONE: › to release or open something that is fixed or closed
解開；鬆開；打開

example: I can't unfasten this button/belt.
我解不開這個扣子／帶子。
This blouse unfastens (= can be unfastened) at the back.
這件上衣是從背後解扣的。

NONE: › impossible to understand
無法理解的；難以理解的

example: For some unfathomable reason they built the toilet next to the kitchen.
不知道爲甚麽，他們把洗手間建在廚房隔壁。

NONE: C2 not giving you an advantage or a good chance of success
不利的；反對的；相反的；有害的；令人不快的
C2 negative and showing that you do not like something
負面的；不喜歡的

example: Current conditions are very unfavourable for new businesses.
目前的條件對新興企業非常不利。
We have to be prepared for an unfavourable outcome.
我們要為結果不利做好準備。
He always talks about her in an unfavourable way.
他在談起她是總是很負面。
Of those surveyed, 62 percent said they had an unfavourable opinion of the president.
62%的受訪者對總統的看法不佳。
The film has had unfavourable reviews.
這部電影的評論不佳。
Opposite
favourable

NONE: › not surprised or worried
不吃驚的；不擔憂的；泰然自若的

example: She seems unfazed by her sudden success and fame.
她看上去對自己的一夜成名處之泰然。

NONE: › not feasible (= able to be done or achieved)
不可行的，行不通的
› not feeling sympathy for other people's suffering
沒有同情心的，冷漠的

example: She accused me of being unfeeling because I didn't cry at the end of the film.
她責備我鐵石心腸，因爲我在影片結尾時沒有哭。

NONE: › not limited by rules or any other controlling influence
不受約束的，自由的

example: Poets are unfettered by the normal rules of sentence structure.
詩人是不受常規句法規則限制的。

NONE: › An unfilled job or position has no one doing or holding it.
（工作或職位）空缺的

example: McCaffrey's job remains unfilled.
麥克卡弗雷的職位還空缺著。
All the hospitals in the area have unfilled positions right now.
這一地區所有醫院都有空缺的職位。

NONE: › not having had solids removed with a filter
未經過濾的
› with no information removed
（資訊）未經過濾的
› used for referring to cigarettes or cigars without filters in one end to remove harmful substances
（香煙）無過濾嘴的

example: The radio station provides millions of people with unfiltered news and political debate.
這家電臺為以百萬計的聽眾提供未經過濾的新聞和政治辯論。

NONE: › not ended or completed
未完成的
› a matter, especially a disagreement, that is not yet decided or agreed
未決事務；（尤指）未解決的分歧

example: I still have some unfinished business with you.
我跟你還有些事情沒處理完。

NONE: B2 not suitable or good enough for a particular purpose or activity
不適合的，不恰當的
B1 mainly UK not healthy because you do too little exercise
不健康的

example: The building was declared unfit for human habitation.
這座大樓被宣佈不適合居住。
I used to take plenty of exercise, but now I'm terribly unfit.
我過去經常進行大量鍛煉，但現在我的身體狀況非常糟糕。

NONE: › If a quality, such as energy, interest, or enthusiasm, is unflagging, it never becomes weaker.
（精力、興趣、熱情等）永不減弱的，不懈的，持久的

example: He thanked Tony for his unflagging energy and support.
他感謝托尼堅持不懈的努力和支持。

NONE: › not likely to get worried, nervous, or angry even in difficult situations
鎮定自若的，沈著冷靜的

example: She's totally unflappable - you have to be when working in such a high-pressure environment.
她非常沈著冷靜——在壓力如此之大的環境下工作必須這樣。

NONE: › making someone look less attractive or seem worse than usual
不恭維的；貶損的；有損形象的

example: an unflattering photo/dress/colour
難看的照片／衣服／顔色
The book portrays her in a very unflattering light.
這本書極大地醜化了她的形象。

NONE: › not frightened of or not trying to avoid something dangerous or unpleasant
不畏縮的；堅定無畏的；不屈不撓的

example: It is a brave and unflinching account of prison life.
這是一篇對獄中生活大膽潑辣的報道。

NONE: › not seeing clearly
看不清楚的，目光茫然的
› not giving a clear image
圖像不清楚的
› not having a central subject or aim
無特定願望（或目標、意圖）的
› used to describe someone who does not have a particular aim or intention
（人）沒有特定目標（或意圖）的

example: Bowman looked up at her, his gaze slightly unfocused.
博曼抬頭看著她，目光有些茫然。
The portrait looks more like an unfocused snapshot.
這幅肖像看上去更像是模糊的快照。
The book is slightly unfocused, as if the author is unsure whether she is writing a romance or a forensic investigation.
這本書有些目標不清，仿佛作者不確定是在寫一部浪漫作品還是法醫調查小說。
There's a part of me that's lazy and unfocused.
我有時候懶惰而且沒有志向。

T: C1 [ T ] to open or spread out something that has been folded

I: C2 [ I ] If a situation or story unfolds, it develops or becomes clear to other people.
（形勢或故事）發展，展現，呈現，披露
T: › [ T ] formal to tell a story or explain something such as a plan

example: He watched her expression as she unfolded the letter.
他注視著她拆信時的表情。
She unfolded a deckchair and sat down.
她打開一個戶外躺椅坐了下來。
Like a lot of people, I've watched the events of the last few days unfold on TV.
和許多人一樣，我這幾天一直在電視上關注著事件的發展。
As the plot unfolds, you gradually realize that all your initial assumptions were wrong.
隨著情節的展開，你會慢慢意識到自己最初的那些猜測都是不對的。
Gradually, the author unfolds a fantastical tale.
作者將一個奇幻的故事一步步地展開。

NONE: › to stop following someone on a social media website (= stop seeing all the messages, pictures etc. that they have published)
（社群網路上）停止跟進
› (of an error) caused by a mistake a player has made rather than as the result of their opponent's skilful play
主動的（失誤）
› done as a result of your own decision, rather than being forced by someone else
非強迫的，自願的
› happening or done without any effort
不費勁的，不勉強的，自然的

example: an unforced agreement between individuals about what to do
個人之間對如何行動的自主協議
natural, unforced laughter
自然且自發的笑聲

NONE: C1 not expected
未預見到的；意料之外的

example: Due to unforeseen circumstances the cost of the improvements has risen by 20 percent.
由於出現了意外情況，裝修成本增加了20%。
Unless there are any unforeseen problems the whole project should be finished by the spring.
除非出現甚麽意外情況，整個工程應該在春季前完工。

NONE: B1 An unforgettable experience has such a strong effect or influence on you that you cannot forget it.
難忘的；無法忘記的
› (of behaviour) too bad to forgive
（行為）過於惡劣無法饒恕的

example: The way he spoke to his brother was unforgivable.
他對自己兄弟說話的態度太惡劣了，無法饒恕。

NONE: B2 unlucky or having bad effects
不幸的，倒楣的
› formal (of remarks or behaviour) not suitable in a way that could cause embarrassment or offence
（言論或行爲）令人尷尬的，不恰當的，得罪人的
› an unlucky person who is in a bad situation
不幸之人；倒楣蛋

example: She has inherited her father's large nose, which is very unfortunate.
她遺傳了父親的大鼻子，真是太不幸了。
[ + (that) ] It was unfortunate (that) he called at the exact moment when our guests were arriving.
遺憾的是他恰好在我們的客人到達時打來電話。
The housing director's comment that "the homeless could do more to help themselves" was unfortunate.
住房主任說的那句「無家可歸者可以做更多的事來自助」是不恰當的。
He was one of the poor unfortunates who invested in the company and now finds himself a few thousand pounds poorer.
他是那些投資這家公司的可憐倒楣蛋之一，現在已經虧了幾千英鎊。

NONE: A2 used to say that something is sad, disappointing, or has a bad effect
不幸地；倒楣地

example: Unfortunately, I didn't have my credit card with me, or else I would have bought it.
很不湊巧，我沒帶信用卡，否則我肯定早買了。

NONE: › If a claim or piece of news is unfounded, it is not based on fact.
（斷言或消息）捕風捉影的，無根據的

example: Our fears about the weather proved totally unfounded.
我們對天氣的擔憂毫無根據。

NONE: defriend
B1 showing dislike and no sympathy
不友好的；有敵意的；冷漠的

example: Opposite
friendly

NONE: › If a wish, hope, promise, etc. is unfulfilled, it has not happened or been achieved.
（願望、希望、諾言等）未實現的，未滿足的，未兌現的
› unhappy because you think you should be achieving more in your life
壯志未酬的，不得志的

example: an unfulfilled ambition/dream
未實現的抱負／夢想

NONE: › disapproving not funny
無趣的，乏味的；沒有吸引力的

example: The jokes are painfully unfunny.
這些玩笑無趣到令人難受。

NONE: › If a flag, sail, or banner unfurls, it becomes open from a rolled position, and if you unfurl a flag, etc., you make it do this
（使）（旗幟、船帆、橫幅等捲著的東西）展開

example: The demonstrators unfurled a large banner.
示威人群打出了一條大大的橫幅。

NONE: › An unfurnished room, house, or other building has no furniture in it.
（房間、房子或其他建築物）無傢俱的
